turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you comfortable with how I am speaking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Please talk a bit slower, my hearing is poor.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Something is wrong with my chest, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What kind of sensation is it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Did it begin suddenly or slowly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It came on slowly last night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel it in your left arm or in your jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nowhere else.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything ease the pain when it is there?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took an antacid and it did not do anything.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only when I hurry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you drenched or clammy during the episodes?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel winded along with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little bit, yes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you blacked out at all?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any heart problems in your close relatives?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother had bypass surgery.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any history of diabetes, blood pressure problems or cholesterol problems, or do you smoke?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high cholesterol. I quit smoking years ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you had any procedure on your heart before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Never, my heart has always been fine.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What are you taking at home for your health?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Clopidogrel and Atorvastatin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: To finish, here is the plan. First, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Second, see the heart specialist within two weeks. To be sure I was clear, what will you do next?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will get the heart tracing and the blood test today and see the heart specialist in two weeks.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Anything else on your mind?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing else, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: All right, we are done. Take care of yourself.
